enabled.label: Enable debug mode
enabled.helperText: Activates DOM snapshot capture and subtitle event monitoring on the current tab

subtitleSelector.label: Subtitle CSS selector
subtitleSelector.helperText: CSS selector for the subtitle elements to monitor. Leave empty to capture full DOM only.

status.noData: No data captured yet. Enable debug mode on a tab with subtitles.
status.noScopedSnapshot: No scoped snapshot. Set a subtitle selector above.
